description: Sets up Jackdaw PR email for a customer domain: an ownership TXT, a DKIM public key, and MX plus SPF on a dedicated reply subdomain. Existing root mail records and nameservers are not changed.
variableDescription: %VERIFICATION%: ownership token shown by the app. %DKIM%: the DKIM public key (p= value) minted for this domain. %MX%: the reply-subdomain mail host. %SPF%: the SPF include rules for the sending relay.
